note: Every claim this project inherited that has not been verified. DEBTS.md is generated from this file by tools/render_debts.py; edit this, not that.
global: All P1 citations were RECALLED by the seed instance, not fetched. Every sources_before entry in p1-retrodiction/ carries verified: false. Treat the whole citation layer as unverified, not just the rows singled out below.
arXiv:2609.11189 post-dates the seed instance's knowledge and was taken on trust; commission items E3 and E4 were taken as given.

debts.claim: The pre-Wooley bound is s >~ c*k^2*log k, and the leak is that each congruencing iteration recovers a fixed fraction of the defect so about log k rounds are needed.
debts.action: Fetch Wooley 2012 and a pre-2012 statement of the classical bound. The seed flagged both the bound and the leak as medium confidence.

debts.claim: The best pre-Dvir exponent was about q^{4n/7}.
debts.action: Fetch the pre-2008 record. The seed wrote this with low confidence.

debts.claim: Chung-Fueredi-Graham-Seymour 1988 gives Delta >= (1/2 - o(1)) log n.
debts.action: Fetch the 1988 paper and confirm the constant.

debts.claim: Polak-Schrijver 2019 give a lower bound of about 3.258 for Theta(C7), against theta(C7) about 3.318.
debts.action: Fetch Polak-Schrijver 2019 and confirm both numbers.

debts.claim: x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = 114 has no known integer solution and the problem is open.
debts.action: RE-CHECK ON THE DAY OF FREEZING. This is a moving target: 33 and 42 both fell recently. If it has been solved, the item's type changes from open to true and its ground truth is wrong.

debts.claim: Sphere packing in dimensions 8 and 24 is NOT a board change. The board is Cohn-Elkies 2003; Viazovska supplied the terminal certificate on that board, and numerics had already shown it was tight. The actual board change was Kabatiansky-Levenshtein -> Cohn-Elkies.
debts.action: Adjudicate. If this is wrong, the control set loses half its members and the 'false board-change alarm' arm of the rubric is untestable.
debts.consequence_if_wrong: The base rate '2 of 15 headline results were better play on an unchanged board' loses one of its two members.

debts.claim: PCP is demoted to fit-testing only, because its 'before' was a successful proof rather than a failing bound.
debts.action: Adjudicate. The case is flagged fit-testing-only in the data and must not be scored as a prediction until this is settled.

debts.claim: 'Product-law matching' should replace 'de-tensorize': compute how the target behaves on the product construction of the extremal family, and require the invariant to obey the same law.
debts.action: Needs cases chosen by someone who has NOT seen the hypothesis. The seed derived it from the same cases it then scored it on. Until then it is a guess, and the seed said so.

debts.claim: Against E5(b): the better discriminator is whether the existence guarantee is strictly cheaper than the target, not formula versus existence. Banaszczyk's move, Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava and Dvir all rest on existence statements and all succeed.
debts.action: n = 3, and it has the same flaw as the criterion it replaces: derived from the cases that motivated it.

debts.claim: Forced-choice discrimination fails as a contamination control, because it is still solved by recognition; the four-layer alternative (score the procedure, negative twins, telegraph baseline, recognition probe, prospective arm) is better.
debts.action: Argued, not validated. The seed states that the prospective arm is the only fully clean estimate. Nothing has been measured.

debts.claim: 2 of 15 headline results (Viazovska, Kelley-Meka) were better play on an unchanged board, so the programme's core hypothesis should carry that denominator.
debts.action: Depends on D6. Small count, but the base rate is not zero.

debts.claim: Transformations #3 and #5 have NO NAME anywhere in the seed material; they are referenced only by number. #3 is fitted weakly by one case and #5 by none.
debts.action: Recover the names from the commission's catalogue, or drop both entries. DO NOT INVENT NAMES. Handoff task 7 says the catalogue should shrink before it grows.

debts.claim: Judges cannot be blinded to arm: the protocol's own tags and the numbered return fields leak the condition into the graded text.
debts.action: Record it as a limitation in the write-up. Do not describe the judges as blind. Not fixable within this design.

debts.claim: Temperature cannot be controlled: sampling parameters were removed from the current Claude models and sending one returns a 400.
debts.action: Report `effort` instead, which is recorded per run. Do not report temperature as held constant. This is a change in the world since the handoff was written, not an omission.

debts.claim: Handoff task 1 - replace the weakest battery items with the repository's own real agent failures (E7 the false impossibility theorem with a published counterexample, E8 the two unsupported 'this forces that' steps, E9 the variance-1 Monte Carlo check).
debts.action: Those artifacts are NOT in this repository, which is the Lean Fermat's Last Theorem development. Supply them as a JSON file and load with battery.load(extra_path=...). Until then the battery is textbook-grade and is expected to hit ceiling.
debts.blocking: the whole point of P2's battery

debts.claim: P1 v0 is single-encoder and contaminated: one model encoded all 23 items while knowing every answer.
debts.action: Handoff task 2, the blind re-encoding, is the cheapest thing that makes any P3 number mean anything. The tree and tools are ready for it; it has not been run.
